newsitem.title: GERMANY: German mineral water sales lose fizz in '96.
newsitem.headline: German mineral water sales lose fizz in '96.

text.p: German mineral water sales fell by three percent in 1996, with the national thirst for the bottled product dampened by a cool summer and poor consumer climate, the Mineral Water Information Centre (IDM) said on Tuesday.
Total mineral water consumption was nine billion litres. Sales, meanwhile, were flat at 4.7 billion marks against 4.8 billion the year before. Consumption per head was 89.3 litres.

The IDM said that bubbly mineral water kept its lead, with a market share of 65.7 percent. But still water took a market share of 28.2 percent, increasing sales volume 3.4 percent to two billion litres.
